name: business-process-modeling
description: Model business processes using BPMN 2.0 conventions. Produces process models with events (start / intermediate / end), activities (tasks / subprocesses), gateways (exclusive / parallel / inclusive / event-based), sequence + message flows, pools + lanes (actors / systems), data objects, and annotations. Current-state (as-is) and future-state (to-be) modes with gap analysis between. Renders Mermaid flowcharts approximating BPMN and optionally emits BPMN XML for dedicated tools. Optional PNG export.
